text:
sam_cust: Hi, hitting intermittent 500s on our private infer endpoint (model-infer). Two request IDs I captured: req_0a1b2c3d and req_0a1b2c4e. Latency spikes ~2s before the 500. Posting the curl I used below so you can repro.

sam_cust: ```
curl -v 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  'https://private.customer.internal/api/v1/generate' 
  -d '{"input":"test prompt"}'
```

maria_support: Thanks — can you run the collector debug on your control plane host and produce a bundle? Use the collector script on the machine that hosts the private control plane (usually /opt/redwood/collector). Example: 

maria_support: ```
/opt/redwood/collector/gather_debug.sh \\--out /tmp/rw-debug-1998765432.tar.gz \\--include-logs \\--include-config \\--include-state \\--redact-keys "Authorization,Authorization-Token,api_key,ssn"
```

maria_support: That will redact sensitive headers/keys and include model config and collector logs. Share the bundle once it's ready.

sam_cust: Running it now on control-01, ETA ~45s. I did see a repeated line in collector.log: "auth: token expired" around the earlier request ids.

alex_ml: If possible include the KV cache snapshot and model metadata files so we can correlate the error to model state. Paths we look for: /var/lib/redwood/kv-cache/*.meta and /etc/redwood/model.yaml

jon_sre: Also please reproduce with an explicit X-Request-Id so we can link traces. Example curl to run after you create a debug bundle: 

jon_sre: ```
curl -v 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "X-Request-Id: repro-1998765432" 
  -H "X-Trace-Id: trace-1998765432" 
  'https://private.customer.internal/api/v1/generate' 
  -d '{"input":"latency test"}'
```

maria_support: When the tarball is ready, please rsync it to our internal upload host (we shared the ssh key via the secure customer channel). Example rsync: 

maria_support: ```
rsync -avz -e 'ssh -i /path/to/support-upload-key -p 2222' \\ /tmp/rw-debug-1998765432.tar.gz support@uploads.redwood-internal.com:/incoming/cust-12345/
```

sam_cust: Ran rsync, got: "Permission denied (publickey)." I'm re-checking the key I received in the secure channel and will retry.

maria_support: If rsync keeps failing, I can create a short-lived HTTP upload token for you. Ping me in-thread and I'll generate it (valid for 10 minutes).

sam_cust: Bundle uploaded successfully on retry. Filename: rw-debug-1998765432.tar.gz, size ~42MB.

deploy-bot: upload-receiver: debug bundle rw-debug-1998765432.tar.gz received from cust-12345 and queued for processing (ticket RW-7890).

alex_ml: Got it. I'll start redaction verification and KV snapshot parsing. If we need more verbose model logs (runtime/engine), I'll ask.

jon_sre: For timing correlation, can you paste the tail around the earlier timestamps? e.g. 

sam_cust: Pasted collector.log excerpt below:

sam_cust: ```
2026-03-16T21:10:08Z collector[pid=2345] INFO incoming request id=req_0a1b2c3d path=/api/v1/generate latency=2100ms
2026-03-16T21:10:10Z collector[pid=2345] WARN auth: token expired for req_0a1b2c3d
2026-03-16T21:10:10Z runner[pid=987] ERROR model-infer failed req=req_0a1b2c3d code=500 msg=unexpected EOF
```

maria_support: :thumbsup: Thanks — eng team will triage against the bundle and the repro. We'll follow up with root cause and next steps in this thread.
